summary.text: Don Schaible is a Republican state senator from District 31 in Mott who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; Ballotpedia lists him as Donald Schaible.
A farmer, he has served in the Senate since 2010 and is an emergency medical technician with the Mott Ambulance Service.

paragraphs.text: Don Schaible earned an associate degree in agriculture from North Dakota State University.
His professional experience includes work as a farmer and as an EMT with the Mott Ambulance Service.

His legislative biography also lists service as past president of the Mott/Regent school board, a role with the Mott Volunteer Fire Brigade, and as a trustee of Zoar Congregational Church, and says he is married with four children.
Schaible assumed office in the North Dakota Senate in 2010.
According to Ballotpedia, he chaired the Senate Education Committee in the 2019-2020 and 2021-2022 sessions.
His 2025 assignments include the Appropriations Committee and its Education and Environment Division.
